case: schema-aware enum-leaf resolution at 257 nested domains under a shadowed search_path
contract: Catalog metadata identifies the target enum leaf through 257 domain layers while another schema's same-named enum is first in search_path.
Schema-aware keyed edits and filters preserve the outer 257th domain and a NULL sibling, including a SET LOCAL shadowed search_path change; rollback restores the pre-transaction row values.
